title: {{name}}: Canvas
description: Add apps and databases and wire them together. Every change is a draft you review as a plan before anything is saved.
loadError: Could not load this project for the canvas. Check your connection and reload.

iacOff.title: Platform as code is switched off
iacOff.description: Canvas turns your draft into a plan with the platform-as-code API, so that feature has to be on before you can review or apply.

empty.title: Nothing in this project yet
empty.description: Add an app or a database from the draft panel to start building. Nothing is created until you apply.

draft.title: Draft
draft.none: No changes yet. Add an app or a database, or connect two things that are already here.

appForm.title: Add an app
appForm.description: A new app that runs a prebuilt image. It joins this project when you apply.
appForm.name: Name

databaseForm.title: Add a database
databaseForm.description: A managed database in this project. It is created when you apply.
databaseForm.name: Name
databaseForm.versionHint: Leave blank to use the engine default.

connect.title: Connect an app to a database
connect.envVarHint: Leave blank and the server picks one.
connect.needBoth: You need at least one app and one database on the canvas to connect them.

connections.title: Connections
connections.none: No app is connected to a database yet.

limits.title: Not editable here yet
limits.body: Volumes, domains, load balancers and dependencies. Change those from the app itself.

errors.format: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.
errors.taken: Something with this name already exists on the canvas.
errors.envVar: Use letters, numbers and underscores, not starting with a number.

review.title: Review changes
review.description: This is what applying would do. Nothing has been changed yet.

planError.title: The plan could not be built
planError.issuesNext: Go back, fix or remove the item named above, then review again.
planError.generic: Check that the server is reachable and that you can write to this project, then try again.

steps.title: Connection changes
steps.note: These run after the plan above is applied, in this order. The server does not preview them.
steps.unsupported: {{app}} reaches {{database}} through its app.yaml, not a connection, so Canvas cannot remove it. Edit app.yaml instead.

applied.title: Applied
applied.failedNext: Nothing after the failed step ran. Fix the cause named below, then review the remaining changes again.

toast.failed: Some Canvas changes did not apply.
